question: List recorded snapshot_date, product_id, year and month from commerce.inventory where snapshot_date='2022-12-31' order by product_id asc limit 10.
List snapshot_date, product_id from commerce.inventory where snapshot_date>='2022-11-01' and snapshot_date<'2023-01-01' and product_id in (1,3) order by snapshot_date asc, product_id asc limit 20.
List product_id, product_name, color, price from commerce.products where color='blue' order by price desc, product_id asc limit 5.
List product_id, category, size, price from commerce.products where product_id in (1,3) and price>=0 order by price asc, product_id asc limit 10.
List product_id, cogs, price from commerce.products where product_id in (1,3) order by product_id asc limit 10.
List product_id, category, segment from commerce.products where category='Streetwear' order by product_id desc limit 5.
